scripts.docs:check: pnpm --filter @refquill/docs api:validate && pnpm --filter @refquill/docs types:check && pnpm --filter @refquill/docs test
scripts.examples:check: pnpm --filter refquill-rust-example generate && pnpm --filter refquill-rust-example check && pnpm --filter refquill-frameworks-example generate && pnpm --filter refquill-frameworks-example check
scripts.build: cargo build --locked && node scripts/stage-native.mjs && pnpm --filter @nickwelsh/refquill-fumadocs build
scripts.schema: cargo run --locked -- schema --output packages/schema && node scripts/schema-types.mjs
scripts.test: cargo test --locked && cargo build --locked && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @nickwelsh/refquill-fumadocs test
scripts.check: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && pnpm --filter @nickwelsh/refquill-fumadocs check
